title: PANAL: We Simplify the Way We Help

blocks.content: PANAL — we simplify the way we help
A targeted social aid management platform: channel all the aid a population may need quickly, efficiently and transparently, with AI agents that validate, prioritize and verify every case.
We simplify the way we help
A state-of-the-art, 100% web and mobile platform for channeling all the aid a population may need quickly, efficiently and transparently.
We have successfully channeled aid to more than 100,000 families and 300,000 people, tracking the process from the moment aid is requested until it becomes a reality.

Using artificial intelligence and cross-checking multiple data sources, we organize all information on families, population groups and housing so that the best possible decisions are made when allocating aid and benefits.
Guided registration, validated in real time

The platform offers step-by-step online forms (wizards) that let applicants register their case. Their data is cross-checked in real time against other information sources to validate it and determine eligibility.
Four stages that ensure aid reaches those who need it most.
Get aid to those who need it most
Request a PANAL demo and learn how to channel aid with full traceability.
The professional, creative and innovative technology partner for public-sector transparency.
